parameters.help_en:
The policy template. Valid values:
promotion: Important Activity template.
bypass: full forwarding

策略模板。取值：
promotion：重大活动
bypass：全量转发

parameters.help_en: The start time when the policy takes effect. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 生效开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒

parameters.help_en: The end time when the policy takes effect. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds

parameters.name: end_time

Success.description_en:
